  - State "DONE"       from "TODO"       [2024-03-01 Fri 10:00]

  This habit has completions spanning the DST transition (March 10, 2024).
  The earliest completion is March 1 (PST), latest is June 15 (PDT).
  Without proper calendar arithmetic, assessment boundaries would drift by 1 hour.
